doc: R6 head-readability check (r3d-cast-hush brief 4.3). px at 1200x540 (the render's 1080-logical values x 0.5), base framing (FOV 30, camera 7.5 m in front of the lane, y 1.9 aimed at 1.35), Hush on the lane z -1.0 in the kitchen, facing right. Orientations: cheat35 = body yaw 90-35 (the idle cheat-out, the face 55 deg off frontal), cheat20 = walking (70 deg off), face_to_camera = cheat 35 + a 25 deg head turn to the audience (the face 30 deg off frontal; R5d / look-at). pupil = the camera-side eye (min of width, height); mouth = the smile's corner-to-corner width; face_card = the face paint's projected width; head = chin to the beret top. Measured by projecting the mesh and the atlas marks (tools: the scratch HushStudio measure.gd), so the numbers are exact for the built glb.

done: face opening widened to x +-0.138 (the bob's sides thinned at the front, B's silhouette kept)
fringe raised to +0.094 over the head centre
eyes 0.062 x 0.078 m with a 0.050 m warm iris + 2 highlights
step1.verdict: fails: head height 54.5 px < 60 in every view (B's head is 0.408 m chin-to-beret), face card <= 33.7 px < 40 even with the face turned to the camera

step2.pivot: the Head joint (B's neck length kept, ruling R6)
step2.condition: passes every bar with the face given to the camera (cheat 35 + a 25 deg head turn); at the bare 35 deg body cheat the horizontal bars (face card, mouth, far-eye pupil) fail for every scale <= 1.3 because horizontal marks shrink by ~cos 55 deg
step2.proposal: head x1.2 (variant head_b: rig3d_head_b.json + hush_head_b.glb, standing 1.674 m)
